quote.text: Constantly observe who those are whose approval you wish to have, and what ruling principles they possess. For then you will neither blame those who offend involuntarily, nor will you want their approval, if you look to the sources of their opinions and appetites.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Reflect on the influences in your child's environment—understand that the values taught by those you admire shape your child’s growth and character.
  • Parenthood: By examining the principles behind the advice you offer, you create an environment that fosters independent thinking rather than mindless approval.
  • Leadership: Observe closely the values and decisions of those you respect—this discernment helps you lead without undue reliance on external validation.
  • Leadership: When you focus on the source of opinions and motivations, you’re better equipped to forgive missteps and avoid the trap of seeking praise over genuine progress.
  • Product Management: In product teams, evaluating the principles behind stakeholder opinions encourages a focus on fundamental product values rather than chasing transient trends.
  • Product Management: Understanding the true motivations of feedback allows you to steer innovation based on authentic user needs rather than superficial approval.
